entity_title: Specialized foreign worker must be replaced by a Panamanian within 5 years
fact_text: An employer may keep specialized or technical foreign staff (up to 15% of the workforce), but under Labour Code art. 17 is obliged to substitute the specialized foreign worker with a Panamanian within a maximum of five years from when the authorization is granted.
evidence_quote: tendrán la obligación de sustituir al trabajador

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a specialized foreign hire can stay indefinitely. Actually the Labour Code (art. 17) obliges the employer to replace the specialized foreign worker with a Panamanian within a maximum of five years. Action: build a national-successor plan into any specialized foreign hire.
